updates.assessment: Physical damage is now independently stronger than in the 16:40 ET drawer. An AFP journalist reported firefighters extinguished a blaze on an Aramco-branded fuel tank at a fuel depot near King Khalid International Airport. Reuters imagery/video independently established flames and heavy smoke near apparent fuel tanks. The Saudi coalition said it intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile aimed at Riyadh and thwarted attacks on Bish, Farasan, Taif and Yanbu. Houthis claimed missile/drone attacks on sensitive Riyadh sites and Aramco facilities at Yanbu. Preserve separately: fuel-depot fire is established; Houthi responsibility for that specific fire/weapon impact is not independently established by the available evidence; Yanbu damage remains unverified.
updates.supersedes: 16:40 ET status that causal link and damage remained wholly unresolved

updates.assessment: CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper stated U.S. forces had supported more than 1 billion barrels of Gulf-partner crude moving through Hormuz in the prior couple of months, assisted more than 2,000 commercial ship transits with coordinated protection, cleared mines from primary transit lanes, and that crude/cargo/LNG volume over the prior two weeks was the highest in six months. Cooper also claimed Iran exported zero barrels because of the U.S. blockade. AP explicitly cautioned that monitors still show shipping traffic well below prewar levels. Preserve CENTCOM's aggregate and zero-Iran-export statement as U.S. military claims; they do not supersede Kpler's narrower daily commodity-vessel counts and do not establish normalized freedom of navigation.
unresolved: Independent denominator/methodology for CENTCOM's 1 billion barrels and 2,000 assisted transits
Independent verification of the zero-Iran-export claim
Latest Kpler daily commodity-vessel count after Thursday September 17

updates.assessment: Rezaei's public messaging contains a material precision issue: in a separate X post he said Iran had transmitted seven conditions for beginning negotiations, but in the Al Jazeera interview only three were publicly identified: end the war on all fronts, release frozen Iranian funds/assets, and end the U.S. naval blockade. The remaining four conditions were not publicly enumerated in sources located this run. Do not collapse 'seven conditions' into the three disclosed conditions or invent the other four. Rezaei also said Iran had not decided to leave the NPT, said its nuclear doctrine remained unchanged, rejected Iranian authority over Bab al-Mandeb as a Yemeni/Houthi matter, and said an Iran-Oman Hormuz framework had been close to announcement before being shelved and remained available subject to possible regional endorsement.
updates.supersedes: 16:40 ET drawer's presentation of the three disclosed conditions as if they were necessarily the complete set
unresolved: Identity and wording of four undisclosed conditions
Whether all seven are strict pre-talk prerequisites, settlement terms, or a mixed package

updates.assessment: Mohsen Rezaei claimed Iran recently test-fired a multi-warhead anti-ship missile near a U.S. vessel or aircraft carrier and said future Iranian responses could target U.S. bases and commercial interests. No independent confirmation, U.S. acknowledgement, telemetry, imagery, NOTAM/NAVWARN, or weapon identification was located in this run. Preserve as claimant-sourced military claim, not established capability or event.

Israel said it struck Hezbollah targets in several areas of southern Lebanon after two Israeli soldiers were wounded when their vehicle drove over what Israel described as a Hezbollah explosive device in Israeli-occupied southern Lebanon. Lebanon's NNA reported three strikes on Nabatiyeh al-Fawqa and said a third nearly hit responding paramedics; it reported no injuries there. Preserve Israeli attribution of the explosive device and target identities as claimant-sourced absent independent confirmation. UNIFIL withdrawal/transfer planning remains unchanged from the earlier drawer.

Pakistan's Foreign Ministry said FM Ishaq Dar discussed uninterrupted energy supplies and safe passage for commercial shipping with Iranian FM Abbas Araghchi, citing effects of disruption on developing countries and global supply chains. This is diplomatic pressure/engagement, not evidence of a new navigation agreement or Iranian concession.

IOM DTM Update #6 reports approximately 114,498 individuals (19,083 households) displaced between September 1 and 17 in the West Coast escalation. Preserve this as the IOM DTM denominator/timebox; do not merge it arithmetically with OCHA/UN figures around 125,000-126,000, which use different coverage/cutoffs. This refines the prior IOM figure in the drawer rather than proving a contradiction.

No material change from the afternoon drawer: Israeli strikes killed at least three Palestinians according to Gaza medical officials. Israel said it targeted military/Hamas operatives. Preserve casualty occurrence separately from Israeli target-status claims.

Syria's Defense Ministry held a funeral for 11 soldiers killed in a blast at Ayash in Deir el-Zour and said several others were wounded. The ministry did not state a cause; SOHR described the location as an arms depot at a military post. No evidence located this run links the blast to Iran-war action. Preserve cause as unresolved and do not attribute externally.
